 with [[Hoori]] when [[Ugayafukiaezu]] was still a child.[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 14:42, 14 May 2025 (UTC)}}

Furutama-no-mikoto (布留多摩命) is a goddess in Japanese mythology.<ref>{{Cite web|title=岸和田のむかし話6　轟川・天の川周辺の話・（3）夜疑神社と唐臼（中井） - 岸和田市公式ウェブサイト|url=https://www.city.kishiwada.osaka.jp/soshiki/3/mukashi6-3-yagijinjatokarausu.html|access-date=2023-12-13|website=www.city.kishiwada.osaka.jp}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=振魂尊|url=https://rekichi.net/s/96486790|access-date=2023-12-13|website=れきち|language=ja}}</ref> She is worshipped at {{ill|Yagi Shrine|ja|夜疑神社|fr|Yagi-jinja}}.<ref>{{Cite web|title=夜疑神社|url=http://www.norichan.jp/jinja/benkyou2/yagi.htm|access-date=2023-12-13|website=www.norichan.jp}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|date=2016-08-18|title=��^�_�Ђ̌�Ր_|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160818202730/http://orange.zero.jp/hara.park/saijin.html|access-date=2024-03-23|website=web.archive.org}}</ref> She is the younger sister of {{ill|Toyotama-hime|en|Toyotama-hime|qid=Q2329261|qid=Q2329261|lt=Toyotama-hime}}.<ref name=":0">https://web.archive.org/web/20231101120705/https://www.city.kishiwada.osaka.jp/soshiki/3/mukashi6-3-yagijinjatokarausu.html</ref>

The {{ill|Shinsen Shōjiroku|en|Shinsen Shōjiroku|qid=Q1045362|lt=Shinsen Shōjiroku}} says she is the daughter of {{ill|Watatsumi|abstract|Q1474187|az|Vatatsumi|de|Watatsumi|es|Watatsumi|fa|واتاتسومی|fr|Watatsumi|hu|Vatacumi|ja|ワタツミ|ko|와타쓰미|mni|ꯋꯇꯠꯁꯨꯃꯤ|pl|Watatsumi|ru|Ватацуми|simple|Watatsumi|uk|Вататсумі|zh|綿津見|qid=Q1474187|lt=Watatsumi}} and [[Oyagami|ancestral deity]] of the {{ill|Yagi clan|ja|八木氏|fr|Clan Yagi}}.<ref>右京神別地祇部「八木造」条。</ref>

She is also an ancestor of the [[Yamato no Kuni no Miyatsuko]].<ref>https://archive.ph/wip/BpEjO</ref> 

== As a Hitorigami ==
Furutama is mentioned as a [[Hitorigami]] in the [[Kujiki]].<ref name=":1" />

== Family tree ==
Many clans may be descendants of Furutama no Mikoto. This includes the {{ill|Owari clan|en|Owari clan|qid=Q11465311|lt=Owari clan}} and [[Yamato no Kuni no Miyatsuko]]. This is a subject of debate.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160422190938/http://wwr2.ucom.ne.jp/hetoyc15/keihu/amabe/amabe-k2.htm|access-date=2023-12-13|website=web.archive.org}}</ref>
